summary: the memory suite's two stack-overrun rows on i686, whose double fault has a task gate, with faults in the guard pages and in vector 8's gate

argv: ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 test-image build/tests/system/harness && ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel images/test.krffs

. tests/system/stackoverrun_row.sh; status=0; for where in fork boot; do stackoverrun_row build/tests/system/harness "$1/kernel" "$1/test.krffs" "$where" "$1/$where.console.log" || status=1; done; exit "$status"

faults.name: guard-mapped
faults.summary: kalloc_guarded mapping the guard page below a stack like the pages above it, which breaks the fork row

lines: stackoverrun: fork: fail: the overrun was not reported

faults.name: boot-guard-mapped
faults.summary: guard_boot_stack leaving the page below the boot stack mapped, which breaks the boot row

lines: stackoverrun: boot: fail: the overrun was not reported

faults.name: interrupt-gate
faults.summary: vector 8 given an interrupt gate that runs on the stack in use, in place of its task gate, which breaks both rows, since the double fault then faults a third time

lines: stackoverrun: fork: fail: the overrun was not reported
stackoverrun: boot: fail: the overrun was not reported
